title: It has a BRIGHT light.
text:
It has a BRIGHT light.. This humidifier is ok for what it is. I used it in Montana and it seemed to be ok for a large room--small or medium would be more effective though. Now I'm in Arizona and I think it's even drier, and I don't think it works as well even in a smaller room, but I'm not 100% sure. It's a fine mid-range humidifier, I think.

Despite the "cool mist" advertisement it's not actually a misting humidifier. You're paying for a fan that sits over water.

It's easy to use, easy to clean, and I don't mind the noise. I prefer a fan sound at night so this does the job of my noisemaker when I use it.

I only have two complaints.

First, I'm annoyed at how expensive the filters have gotten. I used to be able to buy them at Target for like $8 (I've had this humidifier for years), but now I can't find them anywhere so I have to resort to Amazon where they're $12? Geesh. I've switched over to a different brand for filters (Fette Filter, filter A). To make the filters last longer, flip them over every time you add water (I usually did it every other day). I also put one of those Protec humidifier cleaning fish and it keeps the filter and tank clean for longer. Doing those two things, I would clean it about once a month while changing the filter when it got too crusty (maybe every two or three weeks?).

My second complaint is the blue light. It's BRIGHT. It's always on if the machine is on, no matter what. I have rolled up a hand towel and put it in front of the clear water gauge where the light is brightest, but because the machine is a light color it still makes the entire thing glow (and the wall or anything else around it!). I like a dark room at night, and sometimes I just don't have the determination to ignore the glowing blue light in my room so I don't always turn it on.

I've now switched to a BAYKA humidifier that really is a cool mist humidifier and it lets me turn the light completely off while running it. On top of that, I can put essential oils in a sponge ring where the air comes out, though that part isn't that effective like a real oil diffuser. I still like it more than this fan humidifier.

product_metadata.title: Honeywell Cool Mist Humidifier, Medium Room, 1 Gallon Tank, White – Humidifier for Baby and Kids Rooms, Bedrooms and More
features: INVISIBLE COOL MIST HUMIDIFIER – Honeywell Cool Mist Humidifier helps to ensure proper humidity levels in your home. Indoor humidity levels between 40%-60% can help relieve cough and congestion, keep throat and nasal passages hydrated and more.

EASY TO USE – This humidifier with invisible cool mist includes two speed settings to adjust moisture output and sound level. The wicking filter captures minerals from the water, helping reduce white dirt. Features a top fill design for easy fill & clean.

COUGH AND CONGESTION RELIEF – Humidifiers for home can be helpful during cold and flu season, when it’s difficult to sleep with cough and congestion. A humidifier can provide temporary relief by adding necessary moisture to the air.

HUMIDIFIERS FOR BEDROOM AND MORE – A humidifier with invisible moisture is great for a baby, young children and adults, and fits perfectly into any room. Use them when the air is dry, when sick or even just to maintain optimal indoor humidity levels.

COMPATIBLE DOES NOT MEAN COMPARABLE – For best performance, use only a Genuine Honeywell humidifier filter. Compatible humidifier filter replacements are not certified to offer the same performance or efficiency.
description: During cold and flu season, or the air is simply just dry, you can rely on the Honeywell Cool Mist Humidifier. Honeywell humidifiers for bedrooms and beyond add necessary moisture to the air and help ensure proper humidity levels in your home. Indoor humidity levels between 40%-60% can help relieve cough and congestion, keep throat and nasal passages hydrated, temporarily relieve dry air discomfort, protect furniture, decrease static electricity and even keep plants healthier. This cool mist humidifier is ideal for medium rooms. It provides soothing, invisible moisture to relieve dry air discomforts, and features 2 speed settings to adjust moisture output and sound level. The wicking filter captures minerals from the water, helping to prevent white dust. Plus, it features a top fill design for easy fill and clean and the softly illuminated water window indicates when to refill. For best performance, use only a Genuine Honeywell humidifier filter. Compatible humidifier filter replacements are not guaranteed to offer the same performance or efficiency.
